title: Word Cloud Forge
description: Turn any text into a living tag cloud — three layout engines, shape masks, drag-to-pin words, and real PNG/SVG export.
concept: Paste any text (or hand-write a weighted word list) and watch it forge into a tag cloud. Choose between spiral packing, flow rows, or a radial burst layout, mask the cloud into a rectangle, circle, or diamond, then drag individual words to pin them in place before regenerating the rest. Export the result as a crisp PNG or a fully-editable SVG, or copy a shareable link that reconstructs the exact cloud for anyone who opens it.
features: 3 layout algorithms: Archimedean spiral packing with collision detection, flow-wrapped rows, and radial burst rings
3 shape masks (rectangle, circle, diamond) plus 5 color palettes and a frequency-gradient mode
Drag any word to pin it in place, or tap to lock/unlock — regenerate reflows only the unpinned words
Real PNG export (canvas.toBlob) and fully-editable SVG export with matching text/color/rotation
Shareable link (btoa/atob URL hash) reconstructs the exact text, layout, palette and shape
localStorage autosave of source text and settings, seeded RNG keeps reloads deterministic

interaction.mouse: Drag a word to reposition and pin it; click a word to lock/unlock without moving it
interaction.click: Use the sidebar to switch source, layout, shape, palette and rotation, then Regenerate
interaction.touch: Tap ☰ to open the control drawer; drag words directly on the canvas the same as mouse
interaction.keyboard: Tab through sidebar controls; type directly into the text or list textareas
